pages.text: Entangled pairs are made in the middle and their halves sent to the two mouths, a distance L apart. Their fidelity falls as e^(−L/50 km) and with the weaver's temperature, (1 − T/1000 K) - and each pair a second warms it.
$(thing)Set$(): Pair rate, Mouth separation.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Path noise: the coherence length varies by ±5%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): none beyond the recipe windows.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): More pairs, faster weaving.
